fields.value: Based on the PBS children's cartoon, ARTHUR'S ABSOLUTELY FUN DAY offers up a ton of fun for fans of the show. In this single-player game for Game Boy Color, you play as Arthur, who wants to go to the ultimate amusement park, Wonder World. There are over 15 mini-games in Arthur's neighborhood (including air hockey, shooting hoops, cooking pancakes, and a whole lot more), each with its own style of gameplay, from simple timing exercises to mild puzzle solving. You get stars for completing them and once you have enough, you will earn a free pass to Wonder World, where all the mini-games are available for you to play whenever you like. ARTHUR'S ABSOLUTELY FUN DAY is an ideal choice for a younger gamer.

Basado en la serie infantil de PBS, ARTHUR'S ABSOLUTELY FUN DAY ofrece muchísima diversión para los fans del programa. En este juego para un jugador de Game Boy Color, controlas a Arthur, que quiere ir al parque de atracciones definitivo, Wonder World. En el barrio de Arthur hay más de 15 minijuegos (como hockey de aire, tiros a canasta, cocinar panqueques y muchos más), cada uno con su propio estilo de juego, desde ejercicios simples de tiempo hasta acertijos leves. Obtienes estrellas al completarlos y, cuando reúnes suficientes, ganas un pase gratuito a Wonder World, donde todos los minijuegos están disponibles para jugar cuando quieras. ARTHUR'S ABSOLUTELY FUN DAY es una opción ideal para jugadores más jóvenes.
Arthur and his friends decide to enter a soapbox derby, and Arthur must go around his town doing tasks to acquire parts to his car.
Arthur y sus amigos deciden participar en una carrera de carritos de madera (soapbox derby), y Arthur debe recorrer su pueblo realizando tareas para conseguir piezas para su coche.
